title: Expose one normalized effective Multi-Site health alert state
implementation: Added HealthAlertLifecycle.EffectiveAlertState so stale and recovered history cannot be mistaken for a current critical alert.
Exposed effectiveAlertState on direct trend, acknowledgement, and summary responses while retaining raw alertState and recoveryState for auditability.
Updated the browser Multi-Site table and the desktop Site view to consume the normalized state with backward-compatible DTO fallbacks.

verification.tddRed: The new effective-state tests initially failed to compile because HealthAlertLifecycle.EffectiveAlertState did not exist.
verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory design-system color findings remain in app.js

boundary: Live PostgreSQL endpoint serialization, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, and visual responsive verification remain externally unverified.
Full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain outside this local run.
